questions.text: Who actually chose the evacuation destination, and who only helped communicate that choice?

questions.text: Can someone need assistance yet retain authority to decide?

questions.text: Which organization authorized the fire crew to act on its behalf?
questions.source_motivation: delegation is scoped to an action and rule system

questions.text: Did the person agree to relocation or was agreement assumed from silence?

questions.text: When did a person withdraw permission for a representative to act?

questions.text: Who was entitled to take part in the shared water-use discussion?

questions.source_motivation: support and undue influence are not automatically separable from observed outcomes

Was the appointment of a spokesperson accepted by the people represented?
